#!/bin/bash
set -u
base=/workspace/scratch/5e06a74e5f65/durable-restart
cd "$base/inspect-metadata-work-v1" || exit
export PATH="$base/toolchains/go1.27.2/bin:$PATH"
export GOPATH="$base/go-path" GOCACHE="$base/go-cache" GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false CGO_ENABLED=0
unset GOTMPDIR TMPDIR
out="$base/inspect-metadata-evidence-v1"
sqlite='^TestInspectMetadata(EmptyReadonly|GramsRoundTrip|CustomMethodNoCallbacks|CatalogOnlyReads|Quota|Contexts|TransactionAndFreshHeader)$'
cli='^TestInspect(Metadata(DefaultJSON|ExtensionsJSON|EmptyExtensionsJSON|CanceledOutput|OpaqueConfigJSON)|SourceForwardsCallerContext|ContextReadonlyFixtures|ContextCanceled|ReadonlyFixture)$'
step() {
  name="$1"; shift
  printf '\n=== %s\n' "$name"
  printf '%q ' "$@"; printf '\n'
  "$@" > "$out/$name.log" 2>&1
  status=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$out/$name.exit"
  cat "$out/$name.log"
  if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$status"; fi
}
step environment go env GOVERSION GOOS GOARCH CGO_ENABLED GOPATH GOCACHE GOTOOLCHAIN GOPROXY GOSUMDB GOFLAGS GOTMPDIR
step sourceguard go run ./internal/testscope
step sqlite-named go test -count=1 -v ./sqlite -run "$sqlite"
step cli-named go test -count=1 -v ./cmd/gosqlite -run "$cli"
step scoped-vet go vet ./sqlite ./cmd/gosqlite
step library-build go build -trimpath ./sqlite
step cli-build go build -trimpath -o "$out/gosqlite" ./cmd/gosqlite
step sqlite-race env CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -race -count=1 -v ./sqlite -run "$sqlite"
step cli-race env CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -race -count=1 -v ./cmd/gosqlite -run "$cli"

#!/bin/bash
set -u
base=/workspace/scratch/5e06a74e5f65/durable-restart
cd "$base/inspect-metadata-independent-verify-v1" || exit
export PATH="$base/toolchains/go1.27.2/bin:$PATH"
export GOPATH="$base/go-path" GOCACHE="$base/go-cache" GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false CGO_ENABLED=0 GOMAXPROCS=2
unset GOTMPDIR TMPDIR
out="$base/inspect-metadata-independent-review-v1"
sqlite='^TestInspectMetadata(EmptyReadonly|GramsRoundTrip|CustomMethodNoCallbacks|CatalogOnlyReads|Quota|Contexts|TransactionAndFreshHeader)$'
cli='^TestInspect(Metadata(DefaultJSON|ExtensionsJSON|EmptyExtensionsJSON|CanceledOutput|OpaqueConfigJSON)|SourceForwardsCallerContext|ContextReadonlyFixtures|ContextCanceled|ReadonlyFixture)$'
step() {
 name="$1"; shift
 printf '\n=== %s\n' "$name"
 printf '%q ' "$@"; printf '\n'
 "$@" > "$out/$name.log" 2>&1
 status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$out/$name.exit"
 cat "$out/$name.log"
 if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$status"; fi
}
step environment go env GOVERSION GOOS GOARCH CGO_ENABLED GOPATH GOCACHE GOTOOLCHAIN GOPROXY GOSUMDB GOFLAGS GOTMPDIR
step sourceguard go run ./internal/testscope
step sqlite-named go test -count=1 -v ./sqlite -run "$sqlite"
step cli-named go test -count=1 -v ./cmd/gosqlite -run "$cli"
step scoped-vet go vet ./sqlite ./cmd/gosqlite
step library-build go build -trimpath ./sqlite
step cli-build go build -trimpath -o "$out/gosqlite" ./cmd/gosqlite
step sqlite-race env CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -race -count=1 -v ./sqlite -run "$sqlite"
step cli-race env CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -race -count=1 -v ./cmd/gosqlite -run "$cli"
